strongest_positive_advances.statement: A strict-successor prime hit splits into a zero endpoint cylinder of length R_p/p and a maximal-digit cylinder; only the zero cylinder can support eventual rationality. It is enough to escape the zero cylinder at unbounded primes, and R_p/p < 2/p^2.
An arbitrary run of strict-successor digits equal to one is equivalent to one endpoint interval, and any such run forces a factorial-scale reduced-denominator obstruction.

Deleting all pairwise-collision support produces pairwise-coprime private quotients whose product R_p survives primitive endpoint reduction completely. A positive endpoint is at least (rho_p/R_p)/C_p for an explicit nonzero CRT residue rho_p.
Infinitely many primes satisfying rho_p/R_p > C_p (2p+1)/(2p^2(2p-1)!) would prove irrationality.

structural_no_go_results: Every finite divisor-closed incidence matrix for the exact divisor kernel is unit lower triangular, hence unimodular with trivial Smith content.
Sparse exact-kernel rational shadows can preserve prime powers, row-content congruences, prime blocks, and every fixed-dilation congruence while having a prescribed rational sum.
Arbitrary nonconsecutive coefficient-jet minors retaining k prefix directions remain divisible by the k-th power of the common raw denominator, and the bound is sharp.
Any coefficient-jet determinant eliminating all target constants except 1 and S is zero in rank at least three or collapses to the ordinary reduced partial-sum form in rank two.
finite_evidence: The returned exact interval computation reports no prime strict-successor hit below 70000; this has not yet been locally regenerated.
The returned collision-residue checker reports endpoint-support escape for every odd prime p <= 199; this remains a finite certificate.

open_producers.statement: For arbitrarily large primes p, prove fractionalPart((p-1)! S) >= R_p/p.
For infinitely many primes, control the collision core and least positive private-support CRT residue strongly enough to satisfy the exact endpoint-support closing inequality.
Produce primitive channel annihilators with nonzero factorial moment and nonzero residual strictly between -1 and 1.

claim_ceiling: No packet proves the pointwise escape theorem or the irrationality of the Erdős #68 series. Metric almost-everywhere escape, finite computation, and conditional determinant or CRT criteria do not change the open status.
